analysis.title: Circle Internet Group (CRCL): 3Q26 EPS: Puts and takes; Top line & margin beat, vs. substantial 4Q26 QoQ RLDC margin step down guide
key_insights: CRCL reported 3Q26 EPS of 84c vs GSe 27c and Visible Alpha consensus 34c. Core EPS was 75c vs GSe/consensus-like 45c/54c. Adj. EBITDA (ex. SBC) was $317mn vs GSe $196mn and Street $206mn.

GS attributes the stock's same-day underperformance versus other digital asset-adjacent stocks to three factors: the revenue beat came largely from one-time Arc token pre-sale revenue, 4Q26 USDC balance growth has been weaker so far, and guidance implies a lower 4Q26 RLDC margin than consensus.
Management guided to a 2026 RLDC margin ex. Arc presale at the midpoint of the 38-40% range. GS reads this as a ~570bps sequential drop (ex. Arc) to ~34% in 4Q26, vs the Street at 37.5% ex. Arc.

The 4Q26 margin step-down comes from CRCL sharing more reserve economics with distribution partners. 4Q26 is the first full quarter under the renewed Binance agreement, which GS says appears RLDC margin-dilutive.
GS projects 2027E/28E RLDC margins of 34.5%/33.5%, a lower run-rate going into 2027.

Total net revenue was $453mn, 32% above GSe and 28% above consensus. Gross revenue was 11% above GSe/Street and total distribution and other costs were 3% below. RLDC margin was 52.4%, ~775bps above GSe and ~705bps above consensus.
Arc presale revenue was $182mn vs $90mn for GSe/Street, at 100% revenue margin. Ex-Arc other revenue was $25mn, down 25% QoQ on fewer blockchain integrations.

End-of-period USDC in circulation rose ~1% QoQ to $73.9bn, flat YoY. USDC transaction volume rose 49% YoY. Management reiterated its 40% through-the-cycle CAGR target for USDC. Current USDC market cap is 6% lower YoY.
Circle Payment Network annualized payment volume passed $58bn at end-October. Arc Mainnet has 100+ applications and ~$1.5bn of assets on chain since launch.
Ex-Arc RLDC margin was 39.7%, down ~150bps QoQ.
Other revenue guidance of $310-330mn (incl. Arc) is unchanged. GS expects de minimis Arc revenue in 4Q26E and ~$60mn of cumulative Arc presale revenue across 4Q26E/2027E, mostly in 2027E.

Future Arc monetization comes from staking rewards, token sales with no associated costs, and ecosystem incentives. Incentive revenue is fully offset by distribution costs, so it does not affect adj. EBITDA.

Total operating expenses were $245mn, 1% below the Street, with compensation 9% lower and Marketing/IT infrastructure/D&A 33%/22%/13% higher. Adj. EBITDA margin was 69.9%, ~11pp above consensus (~50% ex-Arc).

Management reiterated the 2026 adjusted opex guide of $570-585mn but is tracking toward the high end, citing partnerships and platform investments including the Chelsea Football Club sponsorship for 2026-27.
GS cut 2026E/27E/28E net revenue by 1%/17%/17% and adj. EPS by 3%/34%/28%. 2026E/27E/28E adj. EBITDA margins (ex. SBC) fall by 0.5pp/10.5pp/7.7pp to 54.9%/48.9%/58.0%.
GS raised its target P/E on Q5-Q8 EPS to 34.0x from 30.5x for higher market multiples. The 12-month price target falls 10% to $81 from $90. Rating is Neutral, with the stock at $76.12 (6.4% upside).

market_movers.rationale: Price target cut to $81 from $90 after 2027E/28E EPS cuts of 34%/28% on a lower RLDC margin run-rate and weaker USDC balances. A higher target P/E of 34.0x partly offsets the estimate cuts.

CRCL 3Q26 total net revenue $453mn reported, 32% above GSe and 28% above consensus. Arc presale revenue $182mn reported vs $90mn GSe/Street.
CRCL 3Q26 RLDC margin 52.4% reported (39.7% ex-Arc), vs GSe ~44.7% and consensus ~45.4% implied by the stated ~775bps/705bps beat.
CRCL 4Q26 guidance implies RLDC margin of ~34% ex-Arc, vs Street 37.5% ex-Arc. FY2026 RLDC margin guidance of 41.7%-43.7% is reiterated, ~39% ex-Arc presale.
CRCL 2026 adjusted opex guide $570-585mn unchanged, tracking toward the high end. 3Q26 total opex $245mn, 1% below Street.
crypto_views: USDC in circulation was $73.9bn at end of 3Q26, up ~1% QoQ and flat YoY. USDC market cap is currently 6% below its year-ago level amid a softer digital asset market.
USDC transaction volume rose 49% YoY in 3Q26. Management reiterated a 40% through-the-cycle USDC CAGR target.
Circle Payment Network annualized payment volume passed $58bn at end-October. Arc Mainnet has 100+ applications and ~$1.5bn of assets on chain.

GS lists upside risks as favorable crypto regulation, higher crypto market cap, faster USDT share gains and higher-for-longer rates. Downside risks are slower ecosystem growth, a weaker crypto market, USDT share gains not continuing, Coinbase de-emphasizing USDC, and competition from other stablecoins.
risk_factors: Downside: ecosystem growth slows on a weaker crypto market backdrop.
Downside: market share gains from USDT do not continue.
Further RLDC margin dilution as CRCL shares more reserve economics with distribution partners such as Binance.

tension_points.bull_case: USDC transaction volume rose 49% YoY, Circle Payment Network volume passed $58bn annualized, Arc Mainnet has 100+ applications and ~$1.5bn of assets, and management reiterated a 40% through-the-cycle USDC CAGR target.

tension_points.what_invalidates: A weaker crypto market, USDT share gains not continuing, Coinbase de-emphasizing USDC, or competition from other stablecoins would undercut the bull case.
